name: mtg-data
description: Magic: The Gathering tournament data tooling. One plugin, and more skills land here as they are built.

plugins.name: mtg-data
plugins.description: Magic: The Gathering tournament data, from the scrape through to the meta read. Two skills today: mtg-tournament-analysis reads the format (meta share, win rates, matchup matrices, card-level signal), and deck-check assigns archetype names and pushes them back into the numbers those reads are built on. Local-first: Playwright scrapers pull melee.gg and MTGO onto your own machine, and format eras keep pre-ban results out of post-ban numbers. Run setup.py once after install to build the per-format folder tree and wire up scraping.
